title: Raiders say Ravens have 'backed out of our trade agreement for Maxx Crosby,' who reportedly failed physical

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Raiders say Ravens have 'backed out of our trade agreement for Maxx Crosby,' who reportedly failed physical
sources.description: The Raiders didn't provide any further details of the decision, but The Athletic's Dianna Russini reported shortly after the news broke that Crosby failed his physical.
